name: dsh-buddy-widget
description: DSH 陪伴助手挂件：常驻右下角的小章鱼，实时反映会话状态（摸鱼/思考/回复），每轮结束弹出 token 与金额，今日对话统计（轮次/token/估算费用），可选余额显示（配置 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 后启用，无 key 自动隐藏余额行）。

compatibility.notes: Host bundle plugin: uses only webServer + credentials services and session/event hooks; no client (frontend) package. Runtime files (lib/index.js, lib/widget.js) rely on Node built-ins only, no external npm dependencies. See docs/STORE.md for the permission matrix, external services, failure bounds and disposable-Profile install/start/uninstall evidence.
